messages:
naomi: heads up — attempting to publish sample-sdk, CI blocked by regendiff. it marks public surface changed because a generated README snippet moved into a different file path.
ci-bot: publish job 2001 blocked: regendiff mismatch -> https://ci.redwood.example/2001
eddie: paste diff?
naomi: ```diff
- docs/sdk/usage.md:42: // example: auth flow
+ docs/sdk/examples/auth.md:10: // example: auth flow (moved)
```
pham: file move only, no API change. but our semver pipeline treats file deletion + add as removal+add -> increments minor.
jen: changelog-generator uses file-level diffs; we should switch to a logical API-set comparator that tracks exported symbols and signatures.
naomi: quick unblock: add git mv to preserve history then rerun regen -> regendiff clean. but not always possible when codegen regenerates into new layout.
eddie: small tool: `scripts/regendiff-normalize-moves.js` that heuristically pairs removed+added file blocks with identical content and rewrites diff as move. I'll PR it.
regen-bot: artifact created for job 2001: https://artifacts.redwood/regendiff/2001.txt
pham: long-term: change changelog-generator to compute a canonical representation of the public API (json list of symbols+sig) and diff that. then file moves/comments/ordering won't bump semver.
jen: agreed. filing: https://git.redwood/eng/devex/issues/1700 "regendiff: logical API diffing to avoid semver churn". tagging sdk-parity, semver-risk, docs.
naomi: also documenting onboarding note: "when rearranging generated docs, run `git mv` or use `yarn typegen:preview` and the normalization script before opening release PRs." added to CONTRIBUTING.md.
eddie: PR opened: https://git.redwood/eng/devex/pulls/2410 - add normalization script + CI step. cc @jen @naomi.
ci-bot: rerun preview on PR 2410: regendiff normalized -> publish gate cleared.
naomi: thanks — merging. follow-up: we should expose regendiff artifact link in Console UI to make these investigations easier for non-devex folks.
jen: adding to roadmap item 4.5: regendiff in Console + logical API diffing. :+1:
